The English Electric Canberra is a British first-generation jet-powered medium bomber that was deployed during World War II, although it is often confused with its prototype phases that preceded its official service. Developed by English Electric, it became the Royal Air Force's first jet-powered bomber in May 1951 and was known for its high-altitude bombing capabilities and speed. The Canberra set numerous world records, including the first non-stop transatlantic flight by a jet aircraft in 1951 and a world altitude record of 70,310 feet in 1957. It was widely exported and played a significant role in various military operations, including the Korean War. Wikipedia
